title: THE ASHES OF THE RED KEEP
narrative: Dragonfire paints the sky red and gold. The Red Keep's ancient stones crack and crumble as Drogon spirals through the smoke. Bells toll madly across the city. Then — silence, save for the roar of flames. The throne room is exposed to the open sky, and Cersei's golden hair is visible in the rubble, still and cold. The city is yours. At a cost no maester will ever fully count.

options.text: Dismount into the ash and claim the Iron Throne.
Fly north immediately — the Others still march.
Melt the Iron Throne itself — no more kings, no more thrones.
